seen.title: Marriage 1741: Stipu Cubranicha (Zubranić?) x [..] Strapecha, early February 1741
seen.says: Image 26 left page, the last entry: «Na 2 Febraja Ja Plovan Kuhacevich zakupih u sti Matrimoniy Stipu Cubranicha skherom Pok: [..] Strapecha imenom [..], Kim bi ja svidoka [..] Stighich i Bastul Carich.» The groom's surname is written «Cubranicha» (a C, or a looped Z): read as Čubranić, and a possible early spelling of Žubrinić («Zubranich» of the 1849 Senj deaths and the Baška bride of 1850) only with a query — a seen row, not a found person, until the Žubrinić question of Senj is settled
